sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: When the Statue of Liberty was dedicated in 1886, it was a dull copper color.
sentences.zh: 1886年自由女神像落成时，它呈现出一种暗淡的铜色。

sentences.en: The whole statue is covered with a layer of copper metal about the thickness of two pennies.
sentences.zh: 整座雕像覆盖着一层约两枚硬币厚度的铜皮。

sentences.en: But after about 1900, the physical processes that govern the known universe began to take their toll,
sentences.zh: 但在1900年左右，支配已知宇宙的物理过程开始发挥作用，

sentences.en: and the copper skin oxidized into a greenish patina that can be seen on the statue to this day.
sentences.zh: 铜皮氧化成了至今在雕像上仍能看到的绿色铜锈。

sentences.en: When the statue underwent a massive restoration in the 1980s, the head and shoulder were realigned.
sentences.zh: 当雕像在20世纪80年代进行大规模修复时，头部和肩部被重新校准了。

sentences.en: The point on the crown that had been digging into her arm for a century was shortened.
sentences.zh: 那个已经扎进她手臂一个世纪的皇冠尖端被截短了。

sentences.en: The defects in the internal skeleton were thoroughly addressed.
sentences.zh: 内部骨架的缺陷得到了彻底的解决。

sentences.en: And of course, the weather-beaten exterior was cleaned.
sentences.zh: 当然，饱经风霜的外表也进行了清洗。

sentences.en: But there was no notion that the statue's skin should be returned to the dull copper color she was born with.
sentences.zh: 但当时并没有人认为应该把雕像的皮肤恢复成她诞生时那种暗淡的铜色。

sentences.en: But if they had shined up Lady Liberty to her original copper color,
sentences.zh: 但如果他们把自由女神像擦亮回最初的铜色，

sentences.en: the people of New York City probably would have reacted like this.
sentences.zh: 纽约市民的反应可能会是这样。

sentences.en: I don't like looking at it.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢看它。

sentences.en: This is not someone from New York, as you can probably guess.
sentences.zh: 你可能猜到了，这不是纽约本地人的声音。

sentences.en: That's Barbara Clark.
sentences.zh: 那是芭芭拉·克拉克。

sentences.en: Five generations of her family have lived in Stirling, Scotland.
sentences.zh: 她的家族在苏格兰斯特灵已经生活了五代人。

sentences.en: My name's Barbara Clark, and I've lived in Stirling all my life, apart from when I was at university.
sentences.zh: 我叫芭芭拉·克拉克，除了上大学期间，我一生都住在斯特灵。

sentences.en: Stirling is also the home of Stirling Castle, a truly marvelous place that I just love to visit,
sentences.zh: 斯特灵也是斯特灵城堡的所在地，那是一个我非常喜欢去参观的绝妙地方，

sentences.en: that sits atop a giant crag, or hill, overlooking the whole town of Stirling.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在一块巨大的岩石或山丘上，俯瞰着整个斯特灵镇。

sentences.en: Some castle has been there since the 12th century, and maybe before,
sentences.zh: 自12世纪甚至更早以来，那里就一直有城堡存在，

sentences.en: but the current buildings date from the 15th and 16th centuries.
sentences.zh: 但现存的建筑可以追溯到15和16世纪。

sentences.en: Well, obviously, it's part of our lives.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很明显，它是我们生活的一部分。

sentences.en: We see it every single day, and as children, we played in it.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都能看到它，小时候我们还在里面玩耍。

sentences.en: We ran all around it.
sentences.zh: 我们在它周围到处奔跑。

sentences.en: When we think of medieval castles, we usually picture a grand structure with subdued, dark stone masonry.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到中世纪城堡时，通常会想象出一座有着柔和深色石砌结构的宏伟建筑。

sentences.en: But when you gaze upon Stirling Castle today, from the town below,
sentences.zh: 但当你今天从下方的城镇凝视斯特灵城堡时，

sentences.en: you will notice that one of the buildings is different from the others.
sentences.zh: 你会注意到其中一栋建筑与众不同。

sentences.en: Since 1999, after a long restoration effort, the Great Hall of Stirling Castle has been bright yellow.
sentences.zh: 自1999年经过长期的修复工作后，斯特灵城堡的大厅就变成了亮黄色。

sentences.en: This bright yellow building, you know, sticking out like a sore thumb, and people were just horrified.
sentences.zh: 这栋亮黄色的建筑，你知道，显得格格不入，人们简直被吓坏了。

sentences.en: I can remember just thinking, this is a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时就在想，这简直是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: The story of how the Great Hall of Stirling Castle came to be painted bright yellow
sentences.zh: 关于斯特灵城堡大厅为何被漆成亮黄色的故事，

sentences.en: illustrates the unexpected complexity in the art of restoration.
sentences.zh: 说明了修复艺术中意想不到的复杂性。

sentences.en: It comes down to this question.
sentences.zh: 归根结底就是这个问题。

sentences.en: When you choose to restore something, which moment in time are you restoring it to?
sentences.zh: 当你选择修复某样东西时，你是要把它恢复到哪个历史时刻？

sentences.en: Some kind of nameless group of people reached that decision,
sentences.zh: 某种不知名的群体做出了那个决定，

sentences.en: and I don't question their motives,
sentences.zh: 我并不质疑他们的动机，

sentences.en: but I question their understanding of the effect that it was going to have
sentences.zh: 但我质疑他们是否理解这将会产生的影响，

sentences.en: on people's feelings towards the castle.
sentences.zh: 对人们看待城堡的感受产生的影响。

sentences.en: Who made that decision?
sentences.zh: 是谁做出的那个决定？

sentences.en: Oh, oh, I know.
sentences.zh: 哦，哦，我知道。

sentences.en: It was this guy.
sentences.zh: 是这个人。

sentences.en: My name is Peter Buchanan.
sentences.zh: 我叫彼得·布坎南。

sentences.en: I work with Historic Scotland.
sentences.zh: 我在苏格兰历史环境局工作。

sentences.en: My title now is Project Manager.
sentences.zh: 我现在担任项目经理。

sentences.en: I joined Historic Scotland in 1991 to work on the Stirling Castle project.
sentences.zh: 我于1991年加入苏格兰历史环境局，负责斯特灵城堡项目。

sentences.en: Historic Scotland is the government organisation charged with educating the public
sentences.zh: 苏格兰历史环境局是负责教育公众

sentences.en: and safeguarding Scotland's historic treasures.
sentences.zh: 并保护苏格兰历史瑰宝的政府机构。

sentences.en: They took over the care of Stirling Castle and started the Great Hall restoration in 1991.
sentences.zh: 他们接管了斯特灵城堡的维护工作，并于1991年开始了大厅的修复工程。

sentences.en: First, let's get some castle facts straight.
sentences.zh: 首先，让我们搞清楚一些关于城堡的事实。

sentences.en: The castle, a lot of people have this fairytale Disneyland thing in their heads
sentences.zh: 很多人脑子里对城堡有一种童话般的迪士尼式的幻想，

sentences.en: where it's all one huge building with turrets.
sentences.zh: 认为它是一整座带有塔楼的巨大建筑。

sentences.en: Most medieval castles were a collection of buildings for certain things.
sentences.zh: 大多数中世纪城堡其实是一组建筑的集合，各有用途。

sentences.en: They had a chapel, they had a palace, they would have had kitchens.
sentences.zh: 它们有礼拜堂，有宫殿，还有厨房。

sentences.en: The Great Hall is one of those key buildings in a castle,
sentences.zh: 大厅是城堡中那些关键建筑之一，

sentences.en: and to quote Bill Bryson in his book At Home,
sentences.zh: 引用比尔·布莱森在他的书《居家》中的话，

sentences.en: No room has fallen further in history than the hall.
sentences.zh: “历史上没有哪个房间的地位下降得比大厅更厉害了。”

sentences.en: Now a place to wipe feet and hang hats.
sentences.zh: 现在它只是个擦脚和挂帽子的地方。

sentences.en: Once it was the most important room in the house.
sentences.zh: 曾经，它是房子里最重要的房间。

sentences.en: It is a huge gathering space,
sentences.zh: 它是一个巨大的聚会空间，

sentences.en: and the one here at Stirling was also for the Parliament of Scotland.
sentences.zh: 而斯特灵的这个大厅也曾是苏格兰议会的所在地。

sentences.en: So the kings sat here, they would set laws,
sentences.zh: 所以国王们坐在这里，他们会制定法律，

sentences.en: they would have banquets and feasts,
sentences.zh: 他们会举行宴会和盛宴，

sentences.en: they would entertain lavishly.
sentences.zh: 他们会进行奢华的招待。

sentences.en: And when Peter Buchanan adopted the Great Hall of Stirling,
sentences.zh: 而当彼得·布坎南接手斯特灵大厅时，

sentences.en: it was in an awful state.
sentences.zh: 它处于一种糟糕的状态。

sentences.en: So Stirling Castle, up until 1964, was a military garrison.
sentences.zh: 斯特灵城堡在1964年之前一直是一个军事驻地。

sentences.en: From 1800 to 1964, the castle was owned by the War Office,
sentences.zh: 从1800年到1964年，城堡归陆军部所有，

sentences.en: and they did not treat the castle as a historic artifact to be preserved.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有把城堡当作需要保护的历史文物来对待。

sentences.en: Most of the buildings within the castle were used by them.
sentences.zh: 城堡内的大多数建筑都被他们使用了。

sentences.en: The Great Hall was used as barrack accommodation.
sentences.zh: 大厅被用作营房宿舍。

sentences.en: Turning the one big fancy room into barracks meant adding floors,
sentences.zh: 把这个宽敞华丽的房间改成营房意味着增加楼层、

sentences.en: altering windows, replacing the ceiling, really changing everything.
sentences.zh: 改动窗户、更换天花板，实际上改变了一切。

sentences.en: Once the military left, the place was gutted.
sentences.zh: 军队离开后，这个地方就被掏空了。

sentences.en: And when Peter's team took over in 1991...
sentences.zh: 当彼得的团队在1991年接手时……

sentences.en: The building was a shell.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑只剩下一个空壳。

sentences.en: It still had a military roof on it,
sentences.zh: 它仍然保留着军事时期的屋顶，

sentences.en: but it was left with a huge question mark as to what we should do with it.
sentences.zh: 但对于该拿它怎么办，留下了巨大的问号。

sentences.en: The typical mandate of Historic Scotland is to preserve historic places in the state they were found.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰历史环境局的典型职责是保持历史遗迹被发现时的状态。

sentences.en: But the Great Hall of Stirling Castle required some drastic measures.
sentences.zh: 但斯特灵城堡的大厅需要采取一些激进的措施。

sentences.en: So what state do you restore it to?
sentences.zh: 那么你要把它修复到什么状态呢？

sentences.en: Do you preference the military period from the 1800s or the medieval and renaissance period?
sentences.zh: 你是优先考虑1800年代的军事时期，还是中世纪和文艺复兴时期？

sentences.en: Strategically, the castle had been important for hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: 从战略上讲，这座城堡几百年来一直很重要。

sentences.en: Stirling's role in the history of Scotland has been central since practically the earliest times of first recorded kings.
sentences.zh: 自最早有记录的国王时代以来，斯特灵在苏格兰历史中的地位一直处于核心位置。

sentences.en: Castle Hill overlooks a bog on one side and the bridge over the Fourth River on the other.
sentences.zh: 城堡山一侧俯瞰着沼泽，另一侧俯瞰着福斯河上的桥梁。

sentences.en: So for hundreds of years, it was the place that controlled trade for the whole region.
sentences.zh: 因此，几百年来，它一直是控制整个地区贸易的地方。

sentences.en: Mary, Queen of Scots, was crowned there.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰女王玛丽就是在那里加冕的。

sentences.en: And it was seen that the cultural significance of these things outweighed the significance of the military period.
sentences.zh: 人们认为这些事物的文化重要性超过了军事时期的重要性。

sentences.en: Using this logic, they decided to restore the Great Hall to a state it was about 300 to 400 years in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 基于这种逻辑，他们决定将大厅修复到三四百年前的状态。

sentences.en: But that kind of restoration is not simple.
sentences.zh: 但这种修复并不简单。

sentences.en: First of all, the records aren't all that consistent.
sentences.zh: 首先，记录并不完全一致。

sentences.en: We have a series of etchings of the Great Hall.
sentences.zh: 我们有一系列大厅的蚀刻画。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, they all show slightly different things.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，它们展示的内容略有不同。

sentences.en: Traditionally, you have ridge beasts, heraldic beasts, on the top of the Great Hall.
sentences.zh: 传统上，大厅顶部会有脊兽，即纹章兽。

sentences.en: These are big stone statues of unicorns and lions that sit on the apex of the roof.
sentences.zh: 这些是坐在屋顶顶端的独角兽和狮子的大型石雕。

sentences.en: All of our etchings show these, but they show different numbers of them.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的蚀刻画都展示了这些，但数量各不相同。

sentences.en: So the etchings, they're great to give a kind of an idea of what the castle might have looked like,
sentences.zh: 所以这些蚀刻画对于了解城堡可能的样子很有帮助，

sentences.en: but as a tool for restoration, they weren't of much use.
sentences.zh: 但作为修复工具，它们的用处不大。

sentences.en: To help figure out where the ridge beasts should be placed on top of the building,
sentences.zh: 为了弄清楚脊兽应该放置在建筑顶部的什么位置，

sentences.en: they had to figure out the original structure of the roof.
sentences.zh: 他们必须弄清楚屋顶的原始结构。

sentences.en: Sometime in the 20th century, the roof had been completely replaced by the military.
sentences.zh: 20世纪的某个时候，屋顶被军队完全更换了。

sentences.en: But the original hall had this glorious hammer beam roof.
sentences.zh: 但最初的大厅拥有这种辉煌的锤梁屋顶。

sentences.en: A hammer beam roof is a medieval technique that uses wood beams as a network of cantilevers
sentences.zh: 锤梁屋顶是一种中世纪技术，它利用木梁作为悬臂网络，

sentences.en: and trusses on the inside to make the roof strong over such a big, wide open room.
sentences.zh: 并在内部使用桁架，使屋顶在如此宽敞的房间上方保持坚固。

sentences.en: You can see all the timber when you look up from inside the hall.
sentences.zh: 当你从大厅内部抬头看时，可以看到所有的木材。

sentences.en: It's stunning.
sentences.zh: 它令人惊叹。

sentences.en: It's a jigsaw puzzle of beautiful triangles that are amazing to behold.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由美丽的三角形组成的拼图，看起来非常壮观。

sentences.en: Triangles are the beSt.
sentences.zh: 三角形是最棒的。

sentences.en: Because the ridge beasts weighed three quarters of a ton,
sentences.zh: 因为脊兽重达四分之三吨，

sentences.en: they could only be placed where the hammer beam roof was the strongeSt.
sentences.zh: 它们只能放置在锤梁屋顶最坚固的地方。

sentences.en: This is as true now as it was 300 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这一点现在和300年前一样真实。

sentences.en: We've got a hammer beam roof to construct and we've got no hammer beam roof left.
sentences.zh: 我们需要建造一个锤梁屋顶，但原有的屋顶已经荡然无存。

sentences.en: We want to get it right, but we need clues to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们想把它做好，但我们需要线索才能做到这一点。

sentences.en: They found one diagram, a cross-section of the hammer beam roof of the Great Hall from 1719.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了一张图表，是1719年大厅锤梁屋顶的横截面图。

sentences.en: But since it's the only record, it's hard to know if it's completely accurate.
sentences.zh: 但由于这是唯一的记录，很难知道它是否完全准确。

sentences.en: Since there was no other information about what the roof looked like,
sentences.zh: 由于没有关于屋顶样子的其他信息，

sentences.en: they began researching the surveyors from 1719 who drew the diagram,
sentences.zh: 他们开始研究1719年绘制该图表的测量员，

sentences.en: and they found that other diagrams they drew of other castles were very accurate.
sentences.zh: 发现他们绘制的其他城堡图表非常准确。

sentences.en: So here's our leap of faith.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们的孤注一掷。

sentences.en: This is where you start to have to use conjecture in your restoration to make value judgments.
sentences.zh: 这就是你必须在修复过程中运用推测来做出价值判断的地方。

sentences.en: And we've decided that we will put the whole of the structure back.
sentences.zh: 我们决定将整个结构恢复原样。

sentences.en: So this is what we're basing it on.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所依据的基础。

sentences.en: So using that one historic document, they reconstructed the roof,
sentences.zh: 因此，利用那份历史文献，他们重建了屋顶，

sentences.en: which determined where the heavy stone ridge beasts would be placed on top.
sentences.zh: 这决定了沉重的石制脊兽将被放置在顶部的位置。

sentences.en: One discovery begets another and another, and the original building comes into focus.
sentences.zh: 一个发现引出另一个发现，原始建筑逐渐清晰起来。

sentences.en: And that's the detective work of restoration.
sentences.zh: 这就是修复工作的侦探工作。

sentences.en: Careful research, discovery, verification, sometimes conjecture, leaps of faith.
sentences.zh: 仔细的研究、发现、验证，有时是推测，还有孤注一掷。

sentences.en: It's this beautiful amalgam of history, science, and art.
sentences.zh: 这是历史、科学和艺术的美妙融合。

sentences.en: The hammer beam roof was completed in 1999, and everyone who sees it, including the sterling folk,
sentences.zh: 锤梁屋顶于1999年完工，每个看到它的人，包括斯特灵当地人，

sentences.en: seem to agree, it looks really great.
sentences.zh: 似乎都同意，它看起来真的很棒。

sentences.en: So far, no controversy.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，没有争议。

sentences.en: But as we know, the roof was not the only thing to change.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，屋顶并不是唯一改变的东西。

sentences.en: So the controversy is coming.
sentences.zh: 所以争议即将到来。

sentences.en: The building, when we'd taken it over in 1991, was almost completely grey stone.
sentences.zh: 1991年我们接手时，这座建筑几乎全是灰色的石头。

sentences.en: There was none of the original finishes left.
sentences.zh: 没有任何原始饰面残留。

sentences.en: But in one corner, just under the West Bay, there had been a little lean-to shelter built in front of a door.
sentences.zh: 但在一个角落，西湾下方，门前有一个小棚子。

sentences.en: And when we took it away, we found a complete panel of the original lime wash.
sentences.zh: 当我们把它拆掉时，我们发现了一块完整的原始石灰涂层。

sentences.en: Lime wash is pure lime, meaning calcium oxide, not the green citrus fruit.
sentences.zh: 石灰涂层是纯石灰，即氧化钙，不是那种绿色的柑橘类水果。

sentences.en: And it also contains earth-based pigments.
sentences.zh: 它还含有基于泥土的颜料。

sentences.en: It's a coating that's meant to protect the stone masonry.
sentences.zh: 这是一种旨在保护石砌结构的涂层。

sentences.en: In the case of sterling, they found a significant yellow ochre layer of lime wash.
sentences.zh: 在斯特灵的案例中，他们发现了一层重要的黄色赭石石灰涂层。

sentences.en: The bright yellow was very intentional.
sentences.zh: 这种亮黄色是非常刻意的。

sentences.en: Hundreds of years ago, the built world was basically brown.
sentences.zh: 几百年前，建筑世界基本上是棕色的。

sentences.en: But on this giant hill, there was this great yellow piece of ostentatious bling that signaled for miles that this was a place for a king.
sentences.zh: 但在这一巨大的山丘上，有这块巨大的、炫耀的黄色装饰，向方圆数英里发出信号，表明这里是国王的地方。

sentences.en: And we did huge sample panels of the lime washers all around the building to show people what it might have looked like
sentences.zh: 我们在建筑周围做了巨大的石灰涂层样品板，向人们展示它可能的样子，

sentences.en: and what the colors might have been.
sentences.zh: 以及颜色可能是什么样的。

sentences.en: And we brought a lot of people from the Sterling area to see this as well.
sentences.zh: 我们也带了很多斯特灵地区的人来看这个。

sentences.en: Because what we were intending to do, based on the analysis and the information we had, was to put the finishes back.
sentences.zh: 因为根据我们的分析和信息，我们打算做的是把饰面恢复原样。

sentences.en: And that is exactly what they did.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他们所做的。

sentences.en: Which is why the Great Hall is yellow.
sentences.zh: 这就是大厅是黄色的原因。

sentences.en: Which did not exactly go over well with the people of Sterling.
sentences.zh: 这在斯特灵民众中并没有引起太好的反响。

sentences.en: Strangely, in restoration terms, it's the one element that we had the most evidence for.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，从修复的角度来看，这是我们证据最充分的一个元素。

sentences.en: They actually had physical pieces of the exterior lime wash all over the castle.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上在城堡各处都发现了外墙石灰涂层的实物碎片。

sentences.en: The hammer beam roof, on the other hand, was based much more on conjecture.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，锤梁屋顶则更多是基于推测。

sentences.en: But everyone loves the hammer beam roof.
sentences.zh: 但每个人都喜欢锤梁屋顶。

sentences.en: When Peter's team was putting on the yellow finish, the Great Hall was completely covered in scaffolding and plastic.
sentences.zh: 当彼得的团队在进行黄色饰面施工时，大厅完全被脚手架和塑料布覆盖着。

sentences.en: This may have contributed to the intensity of the reaction from the locals once it was unveiled.
sentences.zh: 这可能加剧了当地人在大厅揭幕后反应的激烈程度。

sentences.en: Here's Sterling resident Barbara Clark again.
sentences.zh: 再次请出斯特灵居民芭芭拉·克拉克。

sentences.en: The entire hall was shrouded in tarpaulin for about ten years.
sentences.zh: 整个大厅被防水布遮盖了大约十年。

sentences.en: And nobody knew really what was going on.
sentences.zh: 而且没人真正知道里面在发生什么。

sentences.en: We knew there were lots of stonemasons up there, but nobody knew anything about anything else.
sentences.zh: 我们知道上面有很多石匠，但没人知道其他任何情况。

sentences.en: So when the Great Unveiling came, it was a total surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以当大揭幕仪式到来时，这完全是一个惊喜。

sentences.en: It just looked so awful.
sentences.zh: 它看起来太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And to this day, I don't like it.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我还是不喜欢它。

sentences.en: When I asked Peter Buchanan what he would have done differently if he had to do it all over again,
sentences.zh: 当我问彼得·布坎南，如果一切重来，他会有什么不同的做法时，

sentences.en: he says he would do all the same restorations, but he would have been more aggressive about outreach.
sentences.zh: 他说他会进行同样的修复工作，但他会更积极地进行外联沟通。

sentences.en: We could have tried harder.
sentences.zh: 我们本可以更努力一些的。

sentences.en: We set up for a couple of weekends down in the center of Sterling to explain what we were doing.
sentences.zh: 我们在斯特灵市中心安排了几个周末，来解释我们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: We had lots of groups and lots of people around to see the samples before we went any further.
sentences.zh: 在进一步行动之前，我们邀请了许多团体和许多人来查看样本。

sentences.en: But really getting that message out through the media and getting people to understand it is very, very difficult.
sentences.zh: 但真正通过媒体传达这一信息并让人们理解它，是非常、非常困难的。

sentences.en: And when it is a change on this scale, I think that possibly a bigger marketing campaign should have gone out there.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到这种规模的改变时，我认为可能应该开展更大规模的营销活动。

sentences.en: This was 15 years ago before Twitter and Facebook made it easier to reach people.
sentences.zh: 那是15年前的事了，在推特和脸书让人们更容易建立联系之前。

sentences.en: Certainly we've learned the experience from the Great Hall as to how we should be getting messages out.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们从大厅的经历中吸取了教训，学会了应该如何发布信息。

sentences.en: If people really understand what you're doing and really buy into it from day one,
sentences.zh: 如果人们真的理解你在做什么，并从第一天起就真心支持它，

sentences.en: then I think it makes it a lot easier to be accepted.
sentences.zh: 那么我认为这会让它更容易被接受。

sentences.en: All restorations are unique.
sentences.zh: 所有的修复都是独一无二的。

sentences.en: I don't think the Statue of Liberty should have been returned to copper when it was restored.
sentences.zh: 我不认为自由女神像在修复时应该恢复成铜色。

sentences.en: As a landmark, people fell in love with it and it gained its significance when it was green.
sentences.zh: 作为一个地标，人们爱上它并赋予它意义时，它已经是绿色的了。

sentences.en: It made sense to keep it that way.
sentences.zh: 保持原样是有道理的。

sentences.en: But I found being in the bright yellow Great Hall at Sterling Castle really exciting.
sentences.zh: 但我发现身处斯特灵城堡那明黄色的大厅里，真的非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm sympathetic to the fact that the color was shocking to the residents who grew up with it looking completely different.
sentences.zh: 我很同情那些从小看着它完全不同样子的居民，这种颜色对他们来说确实很震撼。

sentences.en: But its brightness brought it to life for me and made me reinterpret my faded and ultimately wrong image of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 但它的明亮让我感到它焕发了生机，并让我重新诠释了我对过去那种褪色且最终错误的印象。

sentences.en: It's now assumed that nearly all the Greek and Roman sculptures that we know and love were painted bright, vibrant colors,
sentences.zh: 现在人们普遍认为，我们所熟知和喜爱的大部分希腊和罗马雕塑，原本都被涂上了明亮、鲜艳的颜色，

sentences.en: even though most of us can only imagine them as white marble.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们大多数人只能想象它们是白色大理石的样子。

sentences.en: When I see color reconstructions of ancient statues, I think they look ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 当我看到古代雕像的彩色复原图时，我觉得它们看起来很荒谬。

sentences.en: But I can't help but feel that I know the Greeks and Romans a little bit better after seeing what they thought looked good.
sentences.zh: 但在看到他们认为好看的样子后，我不禁觉得我更了解希腊人和罗马人一点了。

sentences.en: I feel the same about the Renaissance artisans who designed the color schemes inside and outside Sterling Castle.
sentences.zh: 我对那些设计斯特灵城堡内外配色方案的文艺复兴工匠也有同样的感觉。

sentences.en: They were mixing colors that really don't match.
sentences.zh: 他们混合使用的颜色真的不搭。

sentences.en: They were using them in extraordinary ways.
sentences.zh: 他们以非同寻常的方式使用这些颜色。

sentences.en: They were having great fun and showing an awful lot of wealth and power in the process.
sentences.zh: 他们玩得很开心，并在过程中展示了大量的财富和权力。

sentences.en: But this is probably the first and last such restoration for Historic Scotland.
sentences.zh: 但这可能是苏格兰历史环境局此类修复项目的第一次，也是最后一次。

sentences.en: New scanning and 3D rendering technology means that you can quote unquote restore a place
sentences.zh: 新的扫描和3D渲染技术意味着你可以“修复”一个地方，

sentences.en: and teach people what it looked like at any point in history inside the virtual world of a computer exhibit
sentences.zh: 并在计算机虚拟世界的展览中，教导人们它在历史上的任何时刻是什么样子，

sentences.en: without doing anything drastic to the actual physical structure at all.
sentences.zh: 而无需对实际的物理结构做任何剧烈的改动。

sentences.en: And to be honest, I'm much happier with that approach.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我对这种方法感到满意得多。

sentences.en: We can do extraordinary things now through technology that we couldn't have done 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我们现在可以通过技术做一些15年前无法做到的非凡事情。

sentences.en: And it's a really, really easy way to educate people to show them what things might have been like
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常、非常简单的教育方式，可以向人们展示事物曾经的样子，

sentences.en: without being too heavy-handed to the monument.
sentences.zh: 而不会对古迹造成太大的破坏。

sentences.en: So I suspect the Great Hall will remain as a unique restoration in Historic Scotland's history.
sentences.zh: 所以我怀疑大厅将成为苏格兰历史环境局历史上一次独特的修复。

sentences.en: Which totally makes sense.
sentences.zh: 这完全说得通。

sentences.en: But every once in a while, it's nice to be bold and daring like our ancestors were
sentences.zh: 但偶尔，像我们的祖先那样大胆和勇敢一点，

sentences.en: and slap on that bright coat of paint and see just how vivid the world once was.
sentences.zh: 涂上那层鲜艳的油漆，看看世界曾经是多么生动，也是件好事。

sentences.en: So I spent a whole week in Sterling and while I was there,
sentences.zh: 所以我花了一整周时间在斯特灵，当我在那里的时候，

sentences.en: my friends Helen Zaltzman and Martin Ostwick came up to visit from London.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友海伦·扎尔茨曼和马丁·奥斯特威克从伦敦来看我。

sentences.en: Helen and Martin work on the great podcast Answer Me This together,
sentences.zh: 海伦和马丁一起制作了很棒的播客《回答我这个》，

sentences.en: which is one of my absolute favorites.
sentences.zh: 这是我绝对最喜欢的播客之一。

sentences.en: It's won tons of awards and it's incredibly popular in the UK.
sentences.zh: 它赢得了无数奖项，在英国非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: And when we started Radiotopia,
sentences.zh: 当我们创办Radiotopia时，

sentences.en: I talked with Helen about the idea of her doing a new show specifically for us on whatever she wanted.
sentences.zh: 我和海伦谈过，建议她专门为我们制作一个新节目，内容随她喜欢。

sentences.en: Helen is a language and etymology fanatic and she pitched us The Illusionist,
sentences.zh: 海伦是一位语言和词源狂热者，她向我们推荐了《幻术师》，

sentences.en: which I'm going to describe as 99% Invisible for words,
sentences.zh: 我将其描述为“关于词语的《99%隐形》”，

sentences.en: mainly so everyone who listens to this show will understand that if you love 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 主要是为了让所有收听这个节目的人都能明白，如果你喜欢《99%隐形》，

sentences.en: you'll love The IllusioniSt.
sentences.zh: 你也会喜欢《幻术师》的。

sentences.en: You can find out more and subscribe at theillusioniSt.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在theillusionist.org了解更多信息并订阅。

sentences.en: That's illusionist with an A.
sentences.zh: 幻术师（Illusionist）的拼写是以A开头的。

sentences.en: But as a little summertime treat,
sentences.zh: 但作为一点夏日小福利，

sentences.en: I thought I'd just play for you the latest episode of The Illusionist by Helen Zaltzman.
sentences.zh: 我想为你播放海伦·扎尔茨曼制作的最新一期《幻术师》。

sentences.en: Welcome to The Illusionist,
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《幻术师》，

sentences.en: in which I, Helen Zaltzman,
sentences.zh: 在节目中，我，海伦·扎尔茨曼，

sentences.en: swap your cow for five magic linguistic beans.
sentences.zh: 用你的奶牛换取五颗神奇的语言豆子。

sentences.en: Coming up in the show,
sentences.zh: 节目即将开始，

sentences.en: word games!
sentences.zh: 文字游戏！

sentences.en: To prepare yourself for which,
sentences.zh: 为了让你做好准备，

sentences.en: here's a game word.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个游戏词汇。

sentences.en: Game as in the genre of meat is so-called
sentences.zh: 作为肉类种类的“野味”（Game），之所以这样称呼，

sentences.en: because it was obtained through the game or sport of hunting.
sentences.zh: 是因为它是通过狩猎这种游戏或运动获得的。

sentences.en: And this history lurks in venison,
sentences.zh: 这种历史潜藏在“鹿肉”（Venison）一词中，

sentences.en: which evolved from the Latin verb venare,
sentences.zh: 它演变自拉丁语动词venare，

sentences.en: meaning to hunt,
sentences.zh: 意思是狩猎，

sentences.en: and came through English through the Old French venison,
sentences.zh: 并通过古法语词汇venison进入英语，

sentences.en: which meant the meat of a large game animal,
sentences.zh: 意为大型猎物的肉，

sentences.en: usually deer or wild boar.
sentences.zh: 通常是鹿或野猪。

sentences.en: And that's the clue as to why the animal is called a deer
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这种动物被称为“鹿”（deer），

sentences.en: until the point at which it's being eaten,
sentences.zh: 直到它被吃掉的那一刻，

sentences.en: whereupon it becomes venison.
sentences.zh: 在那之后它就变成了“鹿肉”（venison）。

sentences.en: The same with pairings like cow and beef and pig and pork and sheep and mutton.
sentences.zh: 像“牛”（cow）和“牛肉”（beef）、“猪”（pig）和“猪肉”（pork）、“羊”（sheep）和“羊肉”（mutton）这样的配对也是如此。

sentences.en: The words for the creatures in their living state are the Anglo-Saxon ones,
sentences.zh: 这些生物在活着时的称呼是盎格鲁-撒克逊语词汇，

sentences.en: whereas the meat words originated from French.
sentences.zh: 而肉类的词汇则源自法语。

sentences.en: After the Norman invasion of Britain in 1066,
sentences.zh: 1066年诺曼征服英国后，

sentences.en: there came a few hundred years in which the aristocracy were speaking French,
sentences.zh: 有几百年的时间里，贵族们都在说法语，

sentences.en: and they were the ones who could afford to eat the meat.
sentences.zh: 而他们是那些买得起肉吃的人。

sentences.en: And also, they were usually the ones whose words were being recorded in writing for posterity.
sentences.zh: 而且，他们通常也是那些词汇被书面记录下来流传后世的人。

sentences.en: So there you go, meat words.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是肉类词汇的由来。

sentences.en: On with the show.
sentences.zh: 节目继续。

sentences.en: Gather round, children.
sentences.zh: 孩子们，聚过来。

sentences.en: Grandma's got a story about how we had to make our own fun
sentences.zh: 奶奶有个故事，讲的是在我们有iPad之前，

sentences.en: on long, boring journeys before we had iPads,
sentences.zh: 在漫长而无聊的旅途中，我们是如何自娱自乐的，

sentences.en: or indeed any equipment at all beyond vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 或者说，除了词汇量，我们根本没有任何装备。

sentences.en: Because who hasn't had to while away hours stuck in a car or on a bus or a train playing word games?
sentences.zh: 因为谁没在堵在车里、公交车上或火车上时，不得不通过玩文字游戏来打发时间呢？

sentences.en: Such fun.
sentences.zh: 真有趣。

sentences.en: I Spy, where you're listing boring things.
sentences.zh: “我看见”（I Spy），你列举着无聊的东西。

sentences.en: Or The Minister's Cat, where you're listing adjectives.
sentences.zh: 或者“牧师的猫”，你列举着形容词。

sentences.en: The number plate game, where you have to name things that start with the same letters
sentences.zh: 车牌游戏，你必须说出以相同字母开头的东西，

sentences.en: as you can see on the number plate of the car you've been stuck behind in a traffic jam forever.
sentences.zh: 就像你一直堵在交通堵塞中，看着前面那辆车的车牌一样。

sentences.en: Or replacing words in songs with rude words.
sentences.zh: 或者把歌曲里的词换成粗俗的词。

sentences.en: Or the old family favourite, guess how many words you can say before the driver shouts at you to shut up
sentences.zh: 或者那个家庭老传统，猜猜在司机对你大喊闭嘴之前你能说出多少个词，

sentences.en: and you have to sit in silence for two hours.
sentences.zh: 然后你不得不沉默两个小时。

sentences.en: Bonus points if you've got beyond four.
sentences.zh: 如果你超过了四个，还有额外加分。

sentences.en: Here's my issue with these games.
sentences.zh: 这就是我对这些游戏的问题所在。

sentences.en: None of them are actually much fun to play,
sentences.zh: 它们其实一点都不好玩，

sentences.en: except for the replacing words in a song with rude words game, which is still pretty good.
sentences.zh: 除了把歌曲里的词换成粗俗词的游戏，那个还挺不错的。

sentences.en: But really, most of these word games are about as fun as filling in a spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，大多数文字游戏和填表格一样有趣。

sentences.en: They do fulfil the function of obliterating an awkward silence
sentences.zh: 它们确实起到了消除尴尬沉默的作用，

sentences.en: without everyone having to think of conversational topics.
sentences.zh: 而不需要每个人都去想谈话话题。

sentences.en: But the prize isn't so much winning the game
sentences.zh: 但奖励与其说是赢得游戏，

sentences.en: as the journey being over so you don't have to play the game anymore.
sentences.zh: 不如说是旅程结束了，你就不必再玩那个游戏了。

sentences.en: Also, words are all over the place.
sentences.zh: 而且，词语无处不在。

sentences.en: And on the average day, you'll be deploying or taking in many thousands.
sentences.zh: 在平常的一天里，你会使用或接收成千上万个词。

sentences.en: So how do you take these things, which are ubiquitous,
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何利用这些无处不在的东西，

sentences.en: and concoct fun out of them?
sentences.zh: 从中创造出乐趣呢？

sentences.en: What are the elements of a top-notch word game?
sentences.zh: 顶级文字游戏的要素是什么？

sentences.en: A bit of viciousness, I think, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为需要一点恶意。

sentences.en: That's Leslie Scott, the not-very-vicious-looking founder of Oxford Games.
sentences.zh: 那是莱斯利·斯科特，牛津游戏公司那位看起来不太邪恶的创始人。

sentences.en: She has created more than 40 games,
sentences.zh: 她创造了40多种游戏，

sentences.en: a lot of which are word-based, such as anagrams,
sentences.zh: 其中很多是基于文字的，比如变位词游戏，

sentences.en: where you compile anagrams at speed,
sentences.zh: 你需要在其中快速拼凑变位词，

sentences.en: the children's literature game Bookworm,
sentences.zh: 儿童文学游戏《书虫》，

sentences.en: and the bluffing games Flummoxed, Inspiration, and Ex Libris.
sentences.zh: 以及虚张声势游戏《困惑》、《灵感》和《藏书》。

sentences.en: But she's probably best known for a non-word game,
sentences.zh: 但她最出名的可能是一个非文字游戏，

sentences.en: the build-a-precarious tower-out-of-wooden-bricks game Jenga.
sentences.zh: 那个用木块搭建摇摇欲坠塔的游戏——《积木叠叠乐》。

sentences.en: I actually think a game has to be competitive,
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为游戏必须具有竞争性，

sentences.en: otherwise it should be called a different occupation, if you like.
sentences.zh: 否则它应该被称为另一种职业，如果你愿意的话。

sentences.en: I mean, a different kind of pastime.
sentences.zh: 我是说，另一种消遣方式。

sentences.en: There are people who completely disagree with me.
sentences.zh: 有些人完全不同意我的观点。

sentences.en: There are actually companies that are set up to make cooperative games.
sentences.zh: 实际上有一些公司就是为了制作合作游戏而成立的。

sentences.en: I can't imagine it.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象。

sentences.en: No, I mean, I think, in a funny way,
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，我认为，有趣的是，

sentences.en: Jenga is the most cooperative game that I know,
sentences.zh: 《积木叠叠乐》是我所知道的最具合作性的游戏，

sentences.en: but it still has an element that somebody loses.
sentences.zh: 但它仍然有一个有人会输的要素。

sentences.en: A lot of people win it, but there's one person that loses.
sentences.zh: 很多人赢了，但有一个人会输。

sentences.en: And I think if you don't have that element to it,
sentences.zh: 我认为如果你没有那个要素，

sentences.en: it becomes another pastime.
sentences.zh: 它就变成了另一种消遣。

sentences.en: It's not a game, in my opinion.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，那不是游戏。

sentences.en: So you need to bring out people's malevolent side.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要激发人们邪恶的一面。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样。

sentences.en: To bring the fun.
sentences.zh: 为了带来乐趣。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样。

sentences.en: And the element of jeopardy of the possibility
sentences.zh: 以及那种危险的要素，即有可能会

sentences.en: of becoming the worst person in the room.
sentences.zh: 成为房间里最糟糕的人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Several of Lesley's games involve bluffing.
sentences.zh: Lesley 的一些游戏涉及虚张声势。

sentences.en: In Flummoxed, you have to write a definition
sentences.zh: 在《Flummoxed》中，你必须为一个外语单词

sentences.en: for a word from a foreign language.
